champion_top_decile_ch262.unit: the pinned champion's dir_2h score s = P(up) - P(down) from predictions/<capture>/<model>.parquet (write-once uint16 / 65535), top decile by score among engine-eligible rows (elig bit 1) of the non-sports ex-crypto categories (the engine's category not in sports / crypto / unknown); tier = expm1(ms_log_liq); no mid after an origin is read; the k + 1 'unavailable' share reads quotes status codes only (status != 0 or absent)

closes_ch267.unit: ELIG market seen open within 5 h of its end_date (a close); usable = two-sided at the capture 3-5 h and at the capture 1-3 h before end_date, end_date unchanged across the covered captures, no proposal state before the close; availability only, no spread is read

lt14_ch262.unavailable_gap_note: per-tier top-minus-rest unavailable gap printed in champion_top_decile_ch262 (a gap above 10 points fails the census as written)

decisions.resid_ch265_and_fragile_ch268: the builder's by their own lines; the printed correlations and shares are the inputs

fragile_ch268.unit: fr_unavail_12 = share of the 12 previous slots in which the market's quotes status was not 0 or the market was absent from the frame (needs all 12 previous frames present; else the capture's rows are skipped, counted)

kind: CH269 one-shot census and tails map: counts only, k = 0, uncounted; nothing printed is a target, a verdict or a P&L; missing captures are listed as missing and never reconstructed

not_mapped.ask_size_1_coverage: not mapped: sweep 1's ask_size_1 (book_sweeps) is a separate light step; CH263's capacity line is therefore unprinted here
not_mapped.category_lookup: category and tier of a market in the engine's stores are the LATEST sidecar capture's reading (this map's last 8 days); a market not in any covered sidecar is 'unmapped' and counted
not_mapped.ch262_rung_constants_mde: not mapped: the rung constants, MDE and F-MDE and VIF_w of decile membership are design-stage items of the CH262 census text; only the counts, tenure and unavailable share are printed
not_mapped.ch267_identification_gate: not mapped: the within- vs between-stratum SD of the class label and the MDE are design-stage items; the class split and strata counts are printed
not_mapped.fee_class_for_engine_captures: the CH262 fee-class split is printed only for engine captures that lie inside the covered sidecar span, at the capture's own fee_schedule; other captures print fee_na
not_mapped.open_interest: printed as presence only (share of sidecar rows with a non-empty open_interest); when it is empty the tercile arms of CH264 are printed on a LIQUIDITY proxy, labelled as such
not_mapped.proposal_time: the sidecar carries no proposal timestamp; hours-to-liveness arms are unavailable (as the section 0.3 fact 6 says)
not_mapped.rule_class: PLACEHOLDER lexicon of this map (printed in the output), not CH239's parser; counts only, no class is a design input until the builder pins one
not_mapped.tier: liquidity tier = the sidecar rows' liquidity at the capture (< 1k, 1k-10k, 10k-100k, >= 100k); the cost model's own definition is not re-derived here

overdue_ch264.unit: ELIG market at the first covered capture (not the first) where it is >= 2 h past end_date, accepting_orders true, no proposal state, two-sided, mid in [0.05, 0.95]; entries more than 24 h past end_date are 'late' and reported apart; the first covered capture is a warm-up (its entrants are not counted)

label_store_resolutions_by_closed_day.note: markets of the engine's resolution logs (its res_7d candidates, NOT every venue resolution) by closed_time day and category lookup; 'proposal_seen_before_close' = a first-seen proposal state at an earlier covered capture; a lagged read

proposals_ch263.readable_side_note: the status field does not name the proposed side; readable = two-sided with the favoured side's mid >= 0.90 at k (the pinned reading of the CH263 text)
proposals_ch263.unit: first-seen proposal state at k (an open binary row with 'propos' in uma_resolution_statuses at k, none at k - 1, the market present at k - 1); the first covered capture and gap captures have no k - 1 and are unavailable, counted

residual_ch265.unit: residual r = y - (P(up) - P(down)) of the champion's dir_2h on labelled origins (y in {-1, 0, +1} from the engine's direction frame: |dmid| <= 0.005 flat, quote mids at the origin and the next slot); lag-1 pairs are the same market at consecutive origins; correlation with mo_chg_1d at the origin; Pearson

rules_stream.barrier_regex: \b(at any point|at any time|any time|reach(?:es)?|hits?|touch(?:es)?|dips?|exceeds?|before|by (?:january|february|march|april|may|june|july|august|september|october|november|december|the end of))\b
rules_stream.classifier: PLACEHOLDER lexicon of this map (not CH239's parser)
rules_stream.scheduled_regex: \b(scheduled|fomc|federal reserve|cpi|consumer price index|jobs report|nonfarm|unemployment rate|gdp|earnings|box office|election|vote|referendum|certified|official (?:results?|data|release|figures?)|will be (?:released|published|announced)|press release)\b

tails_ch266_map_label_store.unit: markets of the engine's resolution logs with state resolved and y in {0, 1} (the label store's own frame); the price is the market's last two-sided quote in quotes/ (arm 1) or its last two-sided quote at least 24 h before the logged closed_time (arm 2); win rate = share y = 1 (YES won); Wilson 95% CIs; no new resolution is read

tails_ch266_sketch_crossings.unit: first downward crossing per market (mid_{k-1} >= 0.010 > mid_k display; >= 0.015 > mid_k placebo, not also display) over consecutive quotes frames, two-sided at k - 1 and k; category and tier are the latest-sidecar lookup (unmapped counted); k + 1 status read only for 'two_sided at k + 1'; no proposal condition (quotes carry none)
